title: Treasury Daily Interest Rate Statistics (home.treasury.gov)
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Debt Management

manual.how: Open https://home.treasury.gov/policy-issues/financing-the-government/interest-rate-statistics, pick the rate type (Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates, Par Real Yield Curve, Bill Rates, Long-Term Rates, Real Long-Term Rates) and the year, choose Download CSV, and upload one file per year; or open the links in INSTRUCTIONS.md.

cache.why: One small CSV per year (5-20 KB); the current year grows daily, so data/ is reused within a run only.

redistribution.why: Treasury interest rate statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); cite Treasury and the retrieval date.

citation: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Daily Treasury Interest Rate Statistics, {dataset}, home.treasury.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Nominal par yields (CMT) or real (TIPS) yields? Bill rates come as bank discount and coupon equivalent: say which.
Daily values, or monthly or annual averages of business days (Treasury's own averages use business days with data)?
